faqs.a:
(a)
Pursuant to
section 102-40
, the city shall assess the following charges in the event of water service shut-off
               or restoration.
(1)
A charge of $15.00 each time city personnel are dispatched to a property for the purpose
               of water service shut-off.
(2)
A charge of $15.00 each time city personnel are dispatched to a property for the purpose
               of water service restoration.
(3)
A charge of $25.00 for after-hours assistance each time city personnel are dispatched
               to a property for the purpose of turning on the water service if:
(i)
The request to restore water service occurs before payment is made or before arrangements
               for payment are made; and
(ii)
Turning the water on occurs outside the normal business hours of the city which are
               8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday.
If the director of utilities determines significant extenuating circumstances exist,
               the foregoing after hours assistance charge may be waived or reduced.
(4)
Notwithstanding any other charges provided for in this section, all reasonable costs
               incurred by the city that are necessary to shut-off or terminate service to a property
               shall be the responsibility of the property owner.
(b)
There is a charge of $12.00 for a billing name or address change requested by a user
               if such change requires a trip to the property for a special water meter reading.
(c)
There are no service charges during the time period a customer specifically requests
               the water service shut-off up to a maximum period of 12 consecutive months.
(d)
Pursuant to
section 102-40
, the city shall assess the following charges in the event a customer requests a water
               meter calibration or leak detection assistance and the city agrees to provide such
               service:
(1)
There is no charge for the first time during a calendar year that city personnel are
               dispatched to a property for the purpose of calibrating a water meter or for leak
               detection assistance.
(2)
There is a charge of $15.00 for the second time and each successive time during a
               calendar year that city personnel are dispatched to a property for the purpose of
               calibrating a water meter or for leak detection assistance.
(3)
This section of the Code shall not create an obligation upon the city to continue
               offering leak detection assistance.
(4)
If the director of utilities determines significant extenuating circumstances exist,
               the foregoing utility water meter calibration or leak detection assistance charges
               may be waived or reduced.
(e)
A charge of $5.00 will be assessed to an account if payment in the billed amount is
               not physically or electronically received by 5:00 p.m. on the date due. The preceding
               charge shall be waived if: (i) a responsible party has made each payment on time and
               in full over the immediately preceding 18 month time period, and (ii) a responsible
               party has made payment in full within 7 calendar days of the due date of a missed
               payment.
(f)
A charge will not be assessed the first time during a calendar year that city personnel
               are dispatched to a property for a customer requested water service shut-off. A charge
               of $15.00 will be assessed for the second time and each successive time during any
               calendar year that city personnel are dispatched to a property for either a water
               service shut-off or to reinstate water service at a customer's request.
(g)
The charges authorized in this section may be reduced or waived if the director of
               utilities or his designee determines there are significant extenuating circumstances.
               The director of utilities shall establish a policy for evaluating claims of significant
               extenuating circumstance for purposes of this subsection (g).
